authors.name: Chanakya
authors.bio: Traditionally identified as an ancient Indian teacher, philosopher, economist and royal adviser associated with the Mauryan period. The sayings attributed to Chanakya are collected in works commonly known as Chanakya Niti.
authors.notes: Historical portrait attribution is uncertain; add an appropriately licensed image only after verification.

authors.name: Spencer Johnson
authors.bio: Spencer Johnson (1938–2017) was an American physician and author known for presenting practical ideas through short parables, including Who Moved My Cheese? and The One Minute Manager (co-written with Ken Blanchard).

authors.name: Shad Helmstetter
authors.bio: Shad Helmstetter is an author and researcher known for work on self-talk, self-directed thinking and personal development. His book What to Say When You Talk to Yourself explores how internal dialogue can influence attitudes and behavior.

authors.name: Joe Navarro
authors.bio: Joe Navarro is a former FBI special agent and counterintelligence specialist who writes and teaches about nonverbal communication and human behavior.

authors.name: Marvin Karlins
authors.bio: Marvin Karlins is a psychologist, academic and author who has collaborated on books about communication, behavior and business. He is credited as a co-author of What Every BODY Is Saying.

authors.name: Marshall Goldsmith
authors.bio: Marshall Goldsmith is an executive coach and author whose work focuses on leadership, behavior change and professional development. He has advised senior leaders and written books including Triggers and What Got You Here Won't Get You There.

authors.name: Mark Reiter
authors.bio: Mark Reiter is a literary agent and collaborator who has co-authored books with Marshall Goldsmith, including Triggers.

authors.name: Napoleon Hill
authors.bio: Napoleon Hill (1883–1970) was an American self-help author best known for Think and Grow Rich, which presents principles of goal-setting, persistence, personal initiative and achievement.

authors.name: Darius Foroux
authors.bio: Darius Foroux is an author and writer whose work focuses on productivity, habits, decision-making, wealth-building and managing attention.

authors.name: Rhonda Byrne
authors.bio: Rhonda Byrne is an Australian author and producer best known for The Secret and the books that followed it, including The Power, The Magic and Hero.

authors.name: Yogi Ramacharaka
authors.bio: Yogi Ramacharaka is the credited author name on early twentieth-century books about yoga and breathwork. Some bibliographic sources identify the name as a pen name associated with William Walker Atkinson; the attribution should be treated as a historical note rather than a certainty.

authors.name: George S. Clason
authors.bio: George Samuel Clason (1874–1957) was an American author and businessman. He is best known for The Richest Man in Babylon, a collection of parables that teach principles of saving, budgeting and wealth-building.

authors.name: Joseph Murphy
authors.bio: Dr. Joseph Murphy (1898–1981) was a writer and minister associated with the Divine Science movement. His books explored the subconscious mind, belief and the role of thought in personal life.

authors.name: Ryan Holiday
authors.bio: Ryan Holiday is an American author whose books explore Stoic philosophy, strategy, self-discipline and practical approaches to adversity. His works include The Obstacle Is the Way, Ego Is the Enemy and The Daily Stoic.

authors.name: MJ DeMarco
authors.bio: MJ DeMarco is an entrepreneur and author known for writing about entrepreneurship, wealth creation and alternative paths to financial independence, especially in The Millionaire Fastlane.

authors.name: Ben Horowitz
authors.bio: Ben Horowitz is an entrepreneur, investor and co-founder of the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz. His writing draws on experience building and managing technology companies.

authors.name: Robert Greene
authors.bio: Robert Greene is an American author known for books examining power, strategy, human behavior and historical patterns, including The 48 Laws of Power, The Art of Seduction and Mastery.
